query:
SELECT
                p.id,
                p.name,
                p.active,
                p.created_at,
                p.updated_at,
                r.revision,
                r.definition,
                r.created_by,
                r.created_at AS revision_created_at
            FROM profiles p
            JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT revision, definition, created_by, created_at
                FROM profile_revisions
                WHERE profile_id = p.id
                ORDER BY revision DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) r ON true
            ORDER BY p.name
